summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Enhanced Project Management System with auto-generated Project IDs (PRJ-XXXX), enhanced project fields, and Task Dependencies feature. All features working correctly. Fixed a bug: departments collection name mismatch in projects.py (was using 'workos_departments' instead of 'departments').

fixed.issue: Department collection name mismatch - was using 'workos_departments' instead of 'departments'
fixed.fix: Changed db.workos_departments to db.departments in get_department_name() and create_project() functions

project_auto_id_generation.details: Projects auto-generate PRJ-XXXX format IDs (e.g., PRJ-1001, PRJ-A6BA)

project_type_field.details: All 6 project types work: marketing, development, pr, design, operations, other

project_department_field.details: Projects can be associated with departments, department_name enriched in response

project_manager_field.details: Projects can have project_manager_id, project_manager_name enriched in response

project_id_badge_on_cards.details: Project cards in list display PRJ-XXXX badge (verified via UI screenshot)

create_project_modal_fields.details: Modal shows all enhanced fields: Name, Module, Project Type, Department, Project Manager, Description, Priority, Start/End Date

task_dependencies_tab.details: Dependencies tab shows 'Blocked By' and 'Blocks' sections with dropdowns

add_remove_dependencies.details: Dependencies can be added/removed via API. Reverse relationships automatically maintained

blocked_task_indicator.details: Blocked tasks show: red border (border-red-500/30), warning icon, reduced opacity (0.75)

blocked_task_drag_prevention.details: Blocked tasks have draggable=false, non-blocked have draggable=true

blocked_task_api_validation.details: Backend returns 400 error when attempting to move blocked task to in_progress or beyond

dependency_resolution.details: Task can be moved after blocking dependency is completed

critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with proper dependency tracking including reverse relationships
Blocked status validation correctly prevents status changes in backend
Frontend properly reflects blocked state with visual indicators
Auto-generated project_id uses incremental numbering starting from 1001
